name: testSendImsGmsTest
note: Verified via mock sendImsGsmSms(smsc, pdu). Text is TelephonyTest.TAG = getClass().getSimpleName() (TelephonyTest.java:479, SmsDispatchersControllerTest.java:210). SMSC/DA with TON/NPI 0x81 (unknown/ISDN). First octet 01 (SUBMIT, no VP), MR 00. Test is @FlakyTest; MR depends on dispatcher state (first send).

input.text: Hello. This is a really long SMS. It contains more than 160 characters and thus cannot be encoded using a single SMS. It must be split up into multiplé SMS that are concatenated when they are received. Nevertheless, this SMS contains only GSM7 characters!

name: test_pdu_build/1
note: chan_dongle pdu_build_mult(pdus, sca="", dst, ucs2, len, valid_minutes=60, srr=1, csmsref=1) (call at chan_dongle/test/gen.c:69); each part hex compared exactly. PDU starts with 00 (empty SMSC). GSM7 if the text fits the default alphabet, else UCS2 (emoji as surrogate pair D83D DE0B). Concatenation uses 8-bit ref UDH 050003<ref><n><i>. Phone numbers look like test/sample numbers.
